summary: Diagnosis verification task (backend-only). All 4 evidence points confirmed end-to-end: live Render backend is missing IDSPay env vars (config.configured=false, preview returns not_configured), preview backend (localhost:8001) with env vars works correctly (config.configured=true, environment=prod, ready=true), QA GSTIN 29AAAAA0000A1Z5 correctly returns 409 'already registered' (no paid IDSPay call triggered), and Next.js register page renders the amber fallback box exactly when preview.state === 'unavailable' || 'email_unavailable' (needsTypedContact at line 61, JSX gated at line 616). Root cause confirmed: the amber fallback is correct graceful degradation; fix is adding IDSPAY_* env vars on Render.

evidence.preview_preview_qa_gstin: POST http://localhost:8001/api/retailer-auth/gst-contact/preview {gstin:29AAAAA0000A1Z5} => HTTP 409 {"detail":"An account already exists for this GSTIN. Please log in with your GSTIN."} (correct short-circuit, no IDSPay wallet spend)
evidence.frontend_fallback_logic: /app/frontend-next/app/retailer/register/page.js line 61: const needsTypedContact = preview.state === 'unavailable' || preview.state === 'email_unavailable'; line 616-617: renders <div data-testid='register-gst-contact-fallback'> only when needsTypedContact is true. Confirmed intentional graceful-degradation, not an error state.

action_items: USER ACTION (only user can do this): On Render dashboard, add missing backend env vars to the live backend service: IDSPAY_ENV=prod, IDSPAY_API_ID, IDSPAY_API_KEY, IDSPAY_TOKEN_ID, OTP_PEPPER, RESEND_API_KEY and any other keys in local backend/.env. Then redeploy. Re-verify by hitting GET https://www.centraders.com/api/retailer-auth/gst-contact/config — it must return configured:true, environment:'prod', ready:true. After that, the amber fallback on /retailer/register step 2 will stop appearing for normal GSTINs and the registered-contact flow (masked mobile/email + OTP) will render instead.
No code changes needed. Backend code and frontend fallback logic are both correct.
critical_code_review_comments: Graceful degradation chain is well-designed: services/idspay_gst_contacts.py returns status 'not_configured' when _credentials() is None -> routers/retailer_auth.py preview endpoint maps that to {status:'unavailable', reason:'not_configured'} -> frontend sets preview.state='unavailable' -> renders amber fallback with data-testid='register-gst-contact-fallback'. Chain works exactly as intended on live.

Consider adding a tiny banner in the admin dashboard that pings /gst-contact/config and warns admins when configured:false on prod — would prevent silent misconfigurations like the current one from going unnoticed.
seed_data_creation: None. Only 1 preview call made to localhost (against pre-existing QA GSTIN that short-circuits to 409 before IDSPay). Zero IDSPay wallet charges.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Diagnosis fully verified. Nothing to retest until user updates Render env vars. After user updates env, re-run: curl https://www.centraders.com/api/retailer-auth/gst-contact/config and expect configured:true, environment:'prod', ready:true.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: Render deployment for centraders.com backend is missing IDSPAY_ENV, IDSPAY_API_ID, IDSPAY_API_KEY, IDSPAY_TOKEN_ID env vars (backend/.env is gitignored so Render never received them). REPRO: GET https://www.centraders.com/api/retailer-auth/gst-contact/config returns configured:false. CHAIN: services/idspay_gst_contacts.py::_credentials() returns None -> fetch_contacts returns {status:'not_configured'} -> /api/retailer-auth/gst-contact/preview returns {status:'unavailable', reason:'not_configured'} -> frontend-next page.js loadPreview sets preview.state='unavailable' -> needsTypedContact=true -> amber fallback box (data-testid='register-gst-contact-fallback') renders. MITIGATION: Add the missing IDSPAY_* env vars on Render dashboard and redeploy. Same deployed code already works correctly on preview backend (localhost:8001) which has the env vars.
